parity_issues.issue: Web uses a small clay 'Required' chip via [data-testid=required-badge]; mobile uses plain inline 'Required' text next to labels. Both consistently use the WORD 'Required' (no bare asterisks) which satisfies the review-request rule ('web uses the shared RequiredBadge clay chip; mobile shows Required text'). Recorded as a documented intentional parity, not a defect.

Mobile /letters is the mailbox (empty state), NOT the family-cards template picker. The family cards live at /tool/letters-and-follow-ups (correct route). Web equivalent /ai-tools/letters-and-follow-ups is the same picker. Documented so the next agent does not chase a non-issue.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/lib/text_utils.py title_case_name() correctly implements the spec edge rule — only the first letter of each whitespace/hyphen-split token is forced upper (p[:1].upper()+p[1:]) so existing internal caps in 'McDonald' are preserved. Clean and unit-testable.

/app/backend/participant_profile.py _decorate() applies title_case_name to first_name/last_name/preferred_name/name on every read (GET /participants, GET /participants/{id}) and both POST and PATCH re-title-case the incoming payload before Mongo write. Belt-and-braces — future writes from other routes also get corrected on read.

/app/backend/routes/chsp1.py /fee-check/parse-invoice contribution-prefill logic: matches saved chsp_service_entries by service_type first, falls back to any active entry when provider_name is present. Sets rate_from_saved=true + rewrites next_steps[0] to mention the saved rate. Defensive against LLM omissions.

/app/frontend/src/pages/extended/ProviderSwitch.jsx uses one <StepShell> per step (switch-step1..5) with distinct tones (teal/clay/teal/terracotta/sage) — a step-by-step wizard, ONE step at a time, not a scrolled list. Screenshots confirm distinct coloured backgrounds. This is intended UX.

mod-one-quote-nudge is a data-driven banner (renders only when a modification's quotes.length === 1). Verified in source at /app/frontend/src/pages/AthmProjects.jsx:187 (web) and /app/mobile/app/athm-project/[id].tsx:297 (mobile). Cannot exercise without a seeded modification+single-quote fixture; suggest main agent add a seed if end-to-end UI verification is required in a future iteration.
